title: URI Parsing and URL Encoding
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of uri parsing and url encoding in a Ruby program and name the key rule involved.
Apply uri parsing and url encoding in a small example and predict its result before running it.
Identify one boundary or failure case related to safely constructing urls and verify the intended behavior.

content.intro: Learn URI Parsing and URL Encoding through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding uri parsing and url encoding helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: URI Parsing and URL Encoding helps you reason about breaking urls into components. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Breaking URLs into components. Then connect it to Query parameters. The remaining syllabus points—Percent encoding, Safely constructing URLs—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.

content_blocks.title: Example: URI Parsing and URL Encoding
content_blocks.code:
require "uri"
uri = URI("https://example.com/items?q=ruby")
puts uri.host
puts URI.encode_www_form_component("ruby basics")
